items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Used to work with Buddy Petit. That must be him. [INTERVIEWEE] Little short pedal, real short.

ctx.x: Not Chester Lazard, huh? Is Chester Lazard a bass player? Mm-hmm. Little short guy. Chester Lazard is Chester Lazard, they call him. I ain't seen him for years. Used to work with Buddy Petit. That must be him.
